location_address: 7001 Shrimp Rd Dock A Slip #32 Stock Island, FL US 33040
description:
Take Six Fins offshore to one of Florida’s most remote and pristine destinations: the Marquesas Keys, a ring of uninhabited mangrove islands 30 miles west of Key West and the only natural atoll in the Western Hemisphere. Your USCG-licensed captain runs you out aboard our 30' Jeanneau yacht for a day of clear-water snorkeling, deserted-sandbar lunch stops, and backcountry exploration few visitors ever see. The 10-hour option adds time at the historic Marquesas anchorage. Group-only — no shared boats, no other guests.

Quick facts

• 8 hrs $2,070
• 10 hrs $3,065 • Private (your group only) 
• USCG-licensed captain 
• Departs from Perry Hotel & Marina, Stock Island 
• Fuel + safety gear included

itinerary:
Departure – Perry Hotel & Marina
Meet at Dock A, Slip #32. After a safety briefing, we cruise west toward open Gulf waters.

Offshore Cruise (Approx. 60–75 Minutes Each Way)
Enjoy expansive horizon views as we cross toward the remote Marquesas atoll, located approximately 30 miles offshore.

Marquesas Exploration
Once inside the protected crescent of the atoll, your customized experience may include:

• Anchoring at a remote sandbar
• Snorkeling patch reefs and clear flats
• Beach exploration on uninhabited islands
• Dolphin and wildlife viewing
• Flats fishing (optional add-on)
• Eco cruising through mangrove shorelines

Extended Sunset Return (10-Hour Charter Option)
For longer charters, enjoy a golden-hour cruise back toward Key West.

special_requirements:
• Primary booking party must be 21 years or older.
• Children under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
• Guests must be physically able to board and move safely on a vessel in offshore conditions.
• Bareboat charters (7–8 passengers) require a designated renter 21+ to complete the Bareboat Agreement.
• Guests participating in water activities must be comfortable swimming.
restrictions:
• This is an offshore charter and may involve longer travel time and open-water conditions.
• Not recommended for guests who are pregnant.
• Not recommended for guests with serious heart conditions, severe back/neck injuries, or mobility limitations.
• Excessive intoxication may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.
• Smoking or vaping is not permitted inside the cabin.
• Open flames are not permitted onboard.

If you are prone to seasickness, preventative medication is strongly recommended.
extras:
- Fuel is extra for trips with over six passengers at $35/hour.
- Live bait and chum
disclaimers:
• All itineraries are subject to weather, sea conditions, and captain discretion.
• Travel time to the Marquesas is approximately 60–75 minutes each way.
• Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed.
• Water clarity varies daily and seasonally.
• Late arrivals may reduce charter time without refund.
• Six Fins is not responsible for lost or damaged personal items.
